title: CarrotSkin
description: In-game HUD with fancy carrots, custom exhaustion bar and relocated underwater bubbles to display above hp.
body:
Vanilla friendly UI enhancement mod that makes the food bar golden carrots.  
  
***Highlights the carrots** with the players saturation.  
*Shows how much health to heal when holding a food and missing hp.  
  
This is a mostly client-side mod, but it needs to be on the server in order to display accurate saturation/exhaustion values on the client.
  
These features work exactly as {[AppleSkin](https://modrinth.com/mod/appleskin)}.  
***NOT compatable**, use apple **or** use carrot!  

------------------------------------------------------    
     
****EXCLUSIVE TO CARROTSKIN:***  
+Makes exhaustion bar visible **above** food bar.  
  
![CarrotSkin_Bars_IMG](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d51f4debf9f3ce840f44263ba99490cf42f2d7ea.png)  
+Moved underwater air bubbles display from above food -> above health bar.  
  
------------------------------------------------------  
![ALT_CARROTS_IMG](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/771fbcec4490b121a81f3ec4900a423dac724cf7.png)
  
+Resource packs built-in to the mod so you can toggle skins per person!  
  
------------------------------------------------------
